title: A select menu that wraps round its own button
blurb: A customisable <select> whose menu opens over its own button. The button's corner is cut out of the menu, the options flow round the cut, and a press on the button through the cut closes the menu. After the Punch-Out Dropdown by Fabio Azevedo.
question: Can the menu of a customisable <select> open over its own button with the button's shape cut out of it, so that the options flow round the cut and the button under it still takes a press?
result: Yes in Chromium 157. Drawing the hole isn't enough: the picker's box and the canvas both take the press where they have no pixels, so the picker gets pointer-events: none and the canvas gets a clip-path.
